scope: Historical1921Ambassador Hotel central connected building exterior: whole six-storey H-shaped guest block with four splayed end arms/open east and west courts, overhanging dark hipped tile roofs/end ridges, pale stucco/darker sash windows, central rear kitchen/service projection, intrinsic attached lower north dining/cafe/Cocoanut Grove casino volume and east indoor-terrace/entry porch/porte-cochere. Period plans control base topology and relative sections; upper guest-block footprint/sections interpreted from1921aerial. Exclude detached staff/garage ranges and cottages, parcel tennis/landscape/roads/gardens, interiors/grove murals/artwork/lettering/signs/traffic/people, later renovations/ambassador signage and modern Robert F.Kennedy campus. Former hotel demolished; explicit historical-only1921appearance, never default current-world.
